text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...
I'm still not feeling well...
choice_data_list: You look a little pale, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Actually, I tried out a new protein powder...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"It seems my stomach didn't agree with it at all...
Ugh, my tummy hurts..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Whew, I think I'll pass on lunch after all...
It seemed even she couldn't train her digestive system, as Mejiro Ryan remained in poor shape for the rest of the day.
